rule_source: Eduardo's FINAL Entrecueros POS wholesale rule, relayed by Grok in 'Fossiles ERP Desarrollo' on 2026-10-08, plus Eduardo's later answers the same evening: untyped products receive courtesy and can trigger it (final fallback chain), returns/edits repricing dropped, B-1 exact match, agreed classification order, and Entrecueros never sells packaging (rejected with 400).

casual.note: product's own configured tiers replace the list when any is set

sintetica.note: B-1/B1: Q130 per complete group of 3, leftovers Q40; courtesy Q40/unit. B-5/B5 and B-2/B2: Q40 from 4 units, current 40/30 below 4; courtesy Q40. Other synthetics unchanged.

untyped.tiers: product configured 1/3/6/12, catalog price as fallback
untyped.top: 12, else 6, else 3, else unit, else catalog

packaging.note: not sold in Entrecueros: any packaging line rejects the sale and the estimate with HTTP 400

semantics.grouping: Quantity is summed per type across lines; each untyped product (sku_hint) is its own group. A packaging line rejects the whole request (no grouping, no prices).
semantics.trigger: courtesyActive when any group reaches 6 units (equivalently the highest-quantity group reaches 6).
semantics.triggerType: Group with the highest quantity (untyped as 'untyped:<sku_hint>'); an array sorted by name when tied; null when no courtesy.
semantics.ownTier: Highest tier whose minimum <= group quantity; for configured tiers a missing tier falls through to the next lower set tier, then unit, then catalog (main's EntrecuerosVolumePricing).
semantics.courtesyTop: Groups below 6 while courtesy is active get their own top tier.
semantics.rejection: expected {rejected: true, httpStatus: 400, messageContains, paths:[sale, estimate]} replaces prices when any line is packaging
semantics.rounding: Each line rounded to Q0.01 HALF_UP, total = sum of rounded lines.
semantics.serverRecompute: clientUnitPrice in a line is ignored; expectations are server prices.
semantics.statuses: active = must pass; pending = expectation null (open question) or a rejection expectation awaiting approval of Baku's backend PR (packaging-rejected).

assumptions.text: B-1 counts toward sintética quantity for the 3+ tier and the 6-unit trigger. Its own price is Q130 per complete group of 3 and Q40 per leftover unit; courtesy stays Q40/unit.
B-1 is an exact match: trimmed, uppercased code equals 'B-1' or 'B1'. B-10, B-19, B-100 follow normal sintética tiers.
Trigger is 6 units of one type (any group, including reversible and a single untyped product), as on main.
assumptions.status: assumption until Eduardo says otherwise; untyped trigger is final

assumptions.text: 6+ reversibles trigger courtesy, as on main.
Untyped courtesy top: 12, else 6, else 3, else unit, else sale/catalog price. Untyped own tier uses configured tiers with main's fall-through.
The same 12/6/3/unit/catalog chain applied to a partly configured casual product (EC-048).
Entrecueros never sells packaging (Eduardo). Front cannot add it (Pixel's pixel-009); back rejects sale and estimate with 400 'Entrecueros no vende empaque' (Baku's proposal, PR not yet approved).

classification_rule: 1 packaging: code trimmed+uppercased starts with SUM (detected so it can be rejected)

2 cincho: cinchoType CASUAL/REVERSIBLE (case-insensitive), or code starts with FOSS, or name (lowercased, accents removed) contains 'cincho'. reversible if cinchoType REVERSIBLE; else nino if hardware normalizes to NINO; else dama if DAMA or NINA (uppercase, accents and spaces removed, exact); else casual. cinchoForKids ignored

4 billetera: uppercased name contains BILLETERA; synthetic (sintetica) if hardware compacts (uppercase, accents, spaces, underscores removed) to SINTETICO or SINTETICA or starts with SINTETICO: / SINTETICA:, but not when it starts with NOSINTETIC; else leather (billetera)
5 other product with synthetic hardware -> sintetica
6 anything else -> untyped, grouped by productId

classification.description: Reversible cincho with hardware NINO -> reversible wins
Cincho with hardware 'Niño' (accent, mixed case) -> niño
Cincho with cinchoForKids true but no hardware -> casual (cinchoForKids ignored)
Cincho detected by FOSS code prefix, no cinchoType
Cincho detected by name 'Cinchó' (accent removed, lowercased)
Cincho with hardware 'NIÑO DAMA' -> not exact, casual
Other product with synthetic hardware -> synthetic billetera prices
Other product, no synthetic hardware -> untyped, grouped by product id
BILLETERA only in code, not name -> untyped
Non-cincho product with a FOSS code (e.g. a FOSS wallet)
classification.note: Open with Eduardo: does the FOSS prefix alone mean cincho? Rule as written gives casual.
Open with Eduardo: SUM vs SUM- prefix. Rule as written gives packaging.
